line: Send a voice message instead of a text — let them hear you smile.
paragraph: Thalles DeSouza worked at a Wendy's in Cape Cod, Massachusetts. His bosses there funded a scholarship for him. He had survived violence in a neighborhood near Rio de Janeiro. Now he will attend Yale University. Someone heard him, and answered.

seed.summary: A powerful portion of ‘the American dream’ was served by a Wendy’s fast-food restaurant in Cape Cod, Massachusetts, to help out one of its own.
